cards.answer: Darius is a fighter with a tank role. He builds up a physical-damage bleed, pulls enemies toward him, and finishes enemy champions with a true-damage strike.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance from his pull and avoid letting him build up bleed stacks.

cards.answer: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times. Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with Noxian Guillotine temporarily grants Darius bonus attack damage. While empowered, his eligible bleed applications immediately apply five stacks.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before he reaches five stacks on you. Avoid letting an empowered Darius spread full bleed stacks to your teammates.

citations.quote: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Darius' attacks and abilities have to deal damage to apply Hemorrhage.

facts.claim: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times.

citations.quote: When Darius kills a champion with Noxian Guillotine, or applies 5 stacks on an enemy champion, he becomes empowered with Noxian Might for 5 seconds.
Noxian Might: Darius gains 30 – 230 (based on level) bonus attack damage and instantly applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks through his usual means.

facts.claim: Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with Noxian Guillotine temporarily grants Darius bonus attack damage.

passive_visual.description: Blood-drop markers build around the bleeding target; a large emblem appears when Darius becomes empowered.

cards.priority_reason: Full stacks empower Darius and let him spread his strongest bleed to other targets.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Visual cue is a tentative proposal from the supplied official-clip frames, not current-client or skin-specific verification; riot:P identifies the associated passive.
Applications require damage and exclude structures, wards and invulnerable targets; ordinary shields permit application, while spell shields prevent application from abilities.
Q handle hits do not apply or refresh the bleed.
R kills involving clones, resurrection protection or zombie states have empowerment exceptions.

cards.answer: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage. The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage; the inner handle deals less damage and neither applies nor refreshes it. Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of those targets hit.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the swing or inside the blade's reach. Avoid giving him blade hits that heal him.

citations.quote: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle.
Active: Darius briefly winds up to spin his axe in a circle while ghosted, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

facts.claim: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage.

citations.quote: Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle.
When Darius hits a champion with the blade, he applies a Hemorrhage stack and heals based on his missing health, multiplied by the number of champions hit up to 3.

facts.claim: The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage

citations.quote: Enemies hit by the handle receive reduced damage and do not gain a Hemorrhage stack.
Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of Hemorrhage.

Against champions and large monsters hit, Darius heals for 17% – 51% (based on number of targets hit by the outer radius) of his missing health.

facts.claim: Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of those targets hit.

cards.answer: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target. Crippling Strike also resets his basic attack timer.
cards.counterplay: Keep out of his attack reach to avoid the empowered hit and slow.

citations.quote: Active: Darius' next basic attack within a few seconds deals increased physical damage and slows the target.
Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

facts.claim: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target.

citations.quote: Crippling Strike resets Darius' basic attack timer.

facts.claim: Crippling Strike also resets his basic attack timer.

cards.priority_reason: The slow helps him keep targets close, and the attack reset supports repeated attacks.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Attack-reset evidence comes from Wiki only.
A killing hit refunds mana and reduces the cooldown, except against jungle plants; this is not a full cooldown reset.
Wiki reports that spell shields negate the entire empowered attack, including basic-attack damage, and marks this behavior unexpected.

cards.answer: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage. When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Stay outside the cone or move sideways to avoid the pull.

citations.quote: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor.
Passive: Darius gains armor penetration.

facts.claim: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage.

citations.quote: Active: Darius sweeps in a cone in the target direction, slowing and pulling enemies hit towards him.
When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

facts.claim: When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: The pull brings enemies into reach and can catch several targets.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Wiki's rebound-location calculation and simultaneous-stun/brittle interaction are pending testing and are not treated as facts.
The slow begins during the rebound after the pull.
Armor penetration benefits Darius's physical damage; it is not armor reduction for allies.

cards.answer: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target. A qualifying kill lets him use Noxian Guillotine again, through a temporary recast window at earlier ranks or a full cooldown reset at maximum rank.
cards.counterplay: Avoid staying near him at low health, especially with several bleed stacks. Spread out to make follow-up executions harder.

citations.quote: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage.
This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target.
dealing true damage based on the target's current Hemorrhage stacks.

facts.claim: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target.

citations.quote: If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
If the target dies very briefly afterwards, Noxian Guillotine's cooldown is temporarily reset
At max rank, Noxian Guillotine permanently resets its cooldown if the target dies very briefly afterwards.

facts.claim: A qualifying kill lets him use Noxian Guillotine again, through a temporary recast window at earlier ranks or a full cooldown reset at maximum rank.

cards.priority_reason: Stack-enhanced true damage and kill-based reuse can lead to successive executions.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Wiki includes a brief post-hit death window beyond Riot's simpler killing-blow description.
Clone and resurrection-protected kills grant neither reset nor Noxian Might; zombie-state finishes can reset R without granting Noxian Might.
Leap movement depends on distance and terrain; the answer does not imply unrestricted terrain crossing.
R applies its own Hemorrhage stack after dealing damage.

Describe eligible applications and explicitly preserve Q's handle exception instead of claiming every damaging ability hit applies bleed.

conflicts.resolution: Describe qualifying kills and rank-dependent reuse; retain the brief death window and special-target exceptions in QA metadata.
